categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in advanced non-ferrous metal powder materials, including copper-based metal powder materials, high-end microelectronic tin-based solder powder and interconnection materials, 3D printing powder materials, and electronic pastes. These products serve industries such as powder metallurgy, superhard tools, microelectronic packaging, friction materials, catalysts, electrical alloys, carbon products, conductive materials, heat pipe materials, and 3D printing. The business is divided into four main segments: advanced copper-based metal powder materials, high-end microelectronic tin-based solder powder and interconnection materials, 3D printing powder materials, and electronic pastes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes core technologies including spherical metal powder preparation, high-quality electrolytic copper powder green preparation, lead-free environmentally friendly microelectronic solder powder design and preparation, diffusion/composite powder homogenization preparation, ultra-fine metal powder preparation, 3D printing powder preparation, and high-performance powder metallurgy hollow camshaft preparation. Production methods involve electrolytic, atomization, mechanical crushing, chemical, powder metallurgy powder preparation, and post-processing. The company emphasizes green manufacturing, intelligent control, continuous automatic closed powder preparation, and digital workshop technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading automotive parts suppliers, well-known powder metallurgy companies, friction material producers, carbon brush manufacturers, and leading domestic enterprises in powder metallurgy, superhard tools, high-speed rail, and electrical carbon products. Microelectronic solder powder customers include internationally renowned solder manufacturers. End markets span automotive, high-speed rail, machinery, aerospace, microelectronics packaging/assembly, chemical, national defense, tooling, and biomedical sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with industrial bases in Beijing, Chongqing, Anhui, and Shandong, and international bases in the UK and Thailand. Its products are sold globally to over 30 countries and regions including Europe, North America, Latin America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. The company has established a global sales and after-sales service network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the non-ferrous metal powder supply chain, focusing on the design, research, production, and sales of metal powder materials. It procures raw metals such as copper, tin, silver, and nickel, processes them into advanced powder materials, and supplies these to downstream manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core technology competitiveness, expanding downstream application fields, promoting green and intelligent manufacturing transformation, and accelerating product iteration and new product industrialization. R&D focuses on nanometal powder materials, high-strength lightweight alloys, high-temperature alloys, additive manufacturing, and high-reliability electronic solder materials. The company actively collaborates with universities and downstream enterprises and participates in national key R&D programs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of metal powder materials and related products. Pricing follows a 'raw material price plus processing fee' model, with production based on sales orders to mitigate raw material price volatility. Sales are mainly direct with some buyout distribution, supported by technical marketing and customer service.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic and international player in advanced non-ferrous metal powder materials, holding the top domestic market share in copper-based metal powder and tin-based solder powder products. It has strong brand recognition and technological leadership, with competitive advantages in scale, technology, and global market presence. Major competitors are not explicitly named but the company faces increasing competition as the industry matures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.23 billion, a 20.44% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 59.38 million, up 7.73%. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 1.72 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.21 billion. R&D investment accounted for 3.43% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability with expanding production and sales volumes.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, stable-performance metal powder materials with advanced proprietary technologies achieving international leading or advanced levels. It offers customized products with rapid response to customer process optimization needs. Its integrated R&D, production, and global sales network provide differentiated value through innovation, product quality, and comprehensive technical support, enabling it to serve high-end manufacturing sectors and emerging applications such as 3D printing and nanomaterials.
